source: wago.tools DB2 wowf 1.60.1.70790 with hotfixes, plus the Forever client hotfix cache (build 70862, 5,223 records)

talents.name: Arcane Subtlety
ranks: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

talents.name: Arcane Focus
ranks: Improves your chance to hit with Arcane spells by 2%.

talents.name: Improved Channeling
ranks: Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 20% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 14% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Wand Specialization
ranks: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.

talents.name: Magic Absorption
ranks: Increases all your resistances by 2 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 1% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

talents.name: Arcane Concentration
ranks: Gives you a 100% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

talents.name: Arcane Geometry
ranks: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 6 yards.
Increases the effect of your Amplify Magic and Dampen Magic spells by 50%.

talents.name: Arcane Impact
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 6%.

talents.name: Arcane Resilience
ranks: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 50% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Arcane Shielding
ranks: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 33% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 50%.

talents.name: Improved Counterspell
ranks: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 4 sec.

talents.name: Arcane Meditation
ranks: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Presence of Mind
ranks: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

talents.name: Arcane Mind
ranks: Increases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%.

talents.name: Arcane Instability
ranks: Increases the damage done by your spells by 1% and your critical strike chance by 1%.

talents.name: Arcane Power
ranks: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

talents.name: Accelerant
ranks: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Arcane Wrath spells by 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Impact
ranks: Gives your Fire spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.

talents.name: Ignite
ranks: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

talents.name: Flame Throwing
ranks: Increases the range of your Fire spells by 6 yards.

talents.name: Improved Fire Blast
ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec and increases its range by 15 yards.

talents.name: Incineration
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by 6%.

talents.name: Improved Flamestrike
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by 15%.

talents.name: Pyroblast
ranks: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 95 to 125 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.

talents.name: Burning Soul
ranks: Gives your Fire spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 30%.

talents.name: Improved Scorch
ranks: Your Scorch spell has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Improved Fire Ward
ranks: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 20% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

talents.name: Master of Elements
ranks: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 10% of their base mana cost.

talents.name: Critical Mass
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 2%.

talents.name: Blast Wave
ranks: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 148 to 178 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

talents.name: Fire Power
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 3% per your Fire effects on the target, up to a maximum increase of 12%. Effects which mix multiple schools of magic do not qualify.

talents.name: Combustion
ranks: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

talents.name: Frost Warding
ranks: Increases the Armor and resistances granted by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 15%, gives your Frost Ward a 0% chance to negate the warded damage spell, and increases the amount absorbed by your Ice Barrier and Frost Ward by 0%.

talents.name: Improved Frostbolt
ranks: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.1 sec.

talents.name: Precision
ranks: Improves your chance to hit with all spells by 6%.

talents.name: Ice Shards
ranks: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%.

talents.name: Frostbite
ranks: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Improved Frost Nova
ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 4 sec.

talents.name: Permafrost
ranks: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 33% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%.

talents.name: Piercing Ice
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by 2%.

talents.name: Cold Snap
ranks: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

talents.name: Improved Blizzard
ranks: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1 sec.

talents.name: Arctic Reach
ranks: Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 10%.

talents.name: Frost Channeling
ranks: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 15% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 30%.

talents.name: Shatter
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 1%.

talents.name: Ice Block
ranks: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

talents.name: Improved Cone of Cold
ranks: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 15%.

talents.name: Winter's Chill
ranks: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 0% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Ice Barrier
ranks: While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.
